title: FIELD_VALUES search format never returns _explain
answers: Why does ?explain=true have no effect on team search?
Explain/debug scoring missing from field-value search results
Does FIELD_VALUES result format support search explain output?
body: Constraint: the FIELD_VALUES result format explicitly skips the `_explain` field (pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_field_values.go:147); only RESOURCE_TABLE appends an _explain column. Any consumer switching a search request to FIELD_VALUES still gets Explain computed server-side if requested, but has no way to read it back — if the consumer's response type never decoded _explain anyway (as in team search), this is just wasted computation, not a regression. Before relying on explain output with FIELD_VALUES, either keep RESOURCE_TABLE or add explain support to the field-values path first.
applies: Any search handler using ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES with Explain=true
says: Search explain output is missing from search result details
Why doesn't the explain parameter work on team search
Cannot retrieve search scoring information with certain search result formats
search: FIELD_VALUES result format explicitly skips the _explain field, unlike RESOURCE_TABLE which appends it; Explain is computed server-side when requested but cannot be read back through FIELD_VALUES. Any search handler switching to ResourceSearchRequest_FIELD_VALUES with Explain=true will waste server computation if the response path never decoded _explain. Before relying on explain output with FIELD_VALUES, either keep RESOURCE_TABLE or add explain support to the field-values path in pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_field_values.go:147 and consumers like pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/search.go:DoTeamSearch.
